verdict.rationale: Pylon documents a Triggers feature for 'complex workflows and automations' (pylon-docs-30), created from premade templates or from scratch (pylon-docs-62). Webhooks fire on specific events (pylon-docs-63, pylon-docs-32), and background agents can run automatically on incoming issues (pylon-docs-42). Missing for 10: detail on which trigger events, conditions and actions are available, how triggers connect to AI agent actions, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
